name: clay
description: A plasticine claymation cast in a snowy storybook forest. The boss runs the workshop, the worker hauls everything on the sled, the analyst keeps the accounts straight.
style: handmade plasticine claymation in the style of a stop-motion film, soft rounded clay sculptures with visible fingerprint and tooling texture, matte surfaces, gentle warm studio lighting, cosy winter-storybook palette of warm browns, cream snow, deep pine green and knitted red, everything looks sculpted from modelling clay

background.prompt: A snowy forest clearing at dusk seen straight on, sculpted entirely from clay. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper third: a deep dusk-blue forest of snow-dusted pine trees fading into soft darkness, the trees tall only at the extreme left and right edges. A small log cabin with a snow-covered roof and warm glowing windows sits against the extreme right edge, no taller than a quarter of the image. Lower third: a rolling cream snow field stretching the full width with tiny clay footprints and snow lumps. Wide open empty snow middle with nothing in it.

boss.role: owns the workshop and the capital - wants the sleds loaded and the bills paid
boss.look: a plump clay figure with a round body, bushy sculpted eyebrows, a brown clay waistcoat over a cream shirt, a small red necktie, stubby legs, chunky rounded hands

worker.role: does the hauling - the one the snow actually falls on
worker.look: a small round clay figure in a chunky knit mustard hat with a pompom, a thick red knitted scarf, a warm brown clay coat and boots, rosy cheeks, a small round nose

analyst.role: keeps the ledger and explains what the numbers mean
analyst.look: a tidy clay figure with round wire glasses, a mustard knitted bobble hat, a cream clay sweater with a knitted diamond pattern, a small green scarf, holding nothing

_panel_color_note: Cold snow-shadow blue-grey, clearly darker than the cream snow so a panel reads as a sculpted interior wall.
